adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent, `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;` only runs the `.find(...)` branch when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, but the predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `=== undefined/null`). That will almost always return `undefined`, making the lookup effectively dead/misleading and preventing a real destination calendar from being selected. The same flawed pattern is duplicated in deleteEvent: `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`.
